subject.title: Bug: 升级后 Dashboard 历史会话索引/映射错乱

question: What evidence and repair policy should OpenClaw require before relinking a Dashboard session key to a preserved transcript or trajectory when sessions.json already points at another sessionId?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing the correct preserved file from corrupted state can expose or misattach private history, so automation should not choose the permanent recovery policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require a redacted fixture first
options.body: Keep this open until a redacted sessions.json plus transcript or trajectory fixture proves the wrong mapping and can drive a conservative doctor or diagnostic repair.

options.title: Ship read-only diagnostics
options.body: Add tooling that reports suspected mismatches and orphan candidates without mutating mappings until an operator confirms the recovery target.

options.title: Allow heuristic relink
options.body: Permit automated relinking from best-effort content or timestamp matches, accepting higher risk of attaching a Dashboard key to the wrong historical file.

recommendation.title: Require a redacted fixture first
recommendation.body: Keep this open until a redacted sessions.json plus transcript or trajectory fixture proves the wrong mapping and can drive a conservative doctor or diagnostic repair.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate for session-state repair policy from recent source ownership and adjacent migration work.
